## Purpose

Read, write and wipe NFC tags; provision and verify credentials; and track protocol-step eligibility and completion.

## Capability IDs

- `nfc_credential_provisioning`
- `nfc_credential_verification`
- `nfc_tag_read`
- `nfc_tag_write`
- `nfc_tag_wipe`
- `protocol_nfc_check`
- `protocol_nfc_complete`

## Requirements

- NFC-capable Android device.
- Compatible NFC tags.

## Supported XLSForm calls

**From `example_odk_nfc_credential_provisioning.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='nfc_credential_provisioning',input_credential_subject_id=${credential_subject_id_input},input_pin_length=${pin_length_input},input_overwrite_policy=${overwrite_policy_input},return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_nfc_credential_verification.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='nfc_credential_verification',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_nfc_tag_read.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='nfc_tag_read',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_nfc_tag_write.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='nfc_tag_write',input_value=${write_value},input_record_type='text/plain',input_overwrite_policy=${overwrite_policy_input},input_expected_current_hash=${expected_current_hash_input},return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_nfc_tag_wipe.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='nfc_tag_wipe',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_protocol_nfc_check.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='protocol_nfc_check',input_protocol_id='study_protocol_example',input_protocol_version='1',input_step_id='baseline',input_required_bits='00',input_required_value='00',input_completion_bits='01',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_protocol_nfc_complete.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='protocol_nfc_complete',input_protocol_id='study_protocol_example',input_protocol_version='1',input_step_id='baseline',input_required_bits='00',input_required_value='00',input_completion_bits='01',return_mode='flat')
```

## Inputs observed in supplied examples

| Field | Label | XLSForm type |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| start |  | start |
| end |  | end |
| credential_subject_id_input | Credential subject ID | text |
| pin_length_input | PIN length | select_one pin_length |
| overwrite_policy_input | Existing card content | select_one overwrite_policy |
| write_value | Text to write | text |
| overwrite_policy_input | Overwrite policy | select_one overwrite_policy |
| expected_current_hash_input | Expected current message hash | text |
| start | start | start |
